description: Canevas de points de contrôle GNSS - Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Database of GNSS points acquired for the control of orthophotos produced as part of the partnerships for the constitution of a Simplified Street Corps Plan (RSCP) on the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "GNSS control point canvas - Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RTGE, GNSS, Topographie, PCRS, GPS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
